name: Briefed-Fact Re-Probe Council
description: Stop a wrong 'VERIFIED GROUND TRUTH' in an orchestrator brief from propagating into every lane. Each briefed fact is re-probed with a mechanically different instrument BEFORE any lane launches, and the reconciler reads PROBES rather than counting votes - because in the measured baseline 4 of 6 agents refuted a false briefed fact while 2 'CONFIRMED' it by re-running the orchestrator's own broken probe. The pipeline ends in a HARD BARRIER: the fan-out cannot start until every briefed fact carries a verdict and the corrections are emitted. A zero-correction result is itself suspicious and triggers a spot audit rather than a green light.

brief.description: The orchestrator brief whose asserted facts are under test

planned_fanout_size.description: How many agents the brief is about to launch; the reason this gate is cheap by comparison

cross_vendor_on_blast_radius.description: Re-probe cross-vendor any fact whose falsity would invalidate more than two lanes

max_facts.description: Cap on briefed facts extracted from one brief

fact-extractor.description: Pulls every factual assertion out of the brief together with the probe and timestamp the brief cites for it

instrument-assigner.description: Assigns each fact a re-probe that is mechanically DIFFERENT from the brief's own probe and must say why it differs

reprober.description: Re-probes ONE fact. Is told the original probe explicitly and is FORBIDDEN from re-running it; re-running the briefed probe is not a second signal

cross-vendor-reprober.description: Second-vendor re-probe for a fact whose falsity would invalidate more than two lanes

reconciler.description: Resolves a split verdict by READING THE PROBES, never by counting agents; a specific probe beats an agent majority

owner.description: The human owner - the only role that may accept a corrected brief or authorise launching anyway

routes.reason: a same-vendor re-probe can share the mechanism that produced the false fact

stages.title: Extract every asserted fact with its stated probe and timestamp

work_unit.title: Enumerate the brief's factual assertions, each with the probe and date the brief cites
work_unit.question_or_target: List every factual claim the brief asserts as ground truth. For each, record the probe the brief cites and its timestamp, or record that the brief cites NONE - an undeclared source probe is zero signals, not one.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each fact carries its brief offset, the cited probe text or an explicit null, the timestamp, and the count of lanes that would be invalidated if it were false
tests_required: a brief sentence asserting a fact with NO probe must be recorded with probe null, not skipped
both-states: a fact WITH a cited probe in the same brief must carry that probe verbatim
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the instrument assigner rejects any fact whose blast-radius count is missing, because that count drives cross-vendor selection
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0501 emitted only when every asserted fact appears once with a probe field (present or null), a timestamp and a blast-radius count; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0501 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two extractions the owner is asked whether the brief is even fact-shaped

stages.title: Assign a mechanically different re-probe per fact

work_unit.title: Pick a different shell, a different data field or a different measurement per fact
work_unit.question_or_target: For each briefed fact choose a re-probe that differs from the brief's own probe in MECHANISM - a different shell, a different data field, a different instrument - and state the difference in one line. Where no different instrument exists, mark the fact NO-INDEPENDENT-INSTRUMENT.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each row states the original mechanism, the assigned mechanism, and the one-line reason they differ
tests_required: a fact whose brief probe was a Git-Bash `which` must NOT be assigned another Git-Bash `which`; the assignment must name a different shell
a fact with no available alternative instrument must be marked NO-INDEPENDENT-INSTRUMENT rather than assigned the original
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the independence gate recomputes mechanism equality independently of this stage's own claim
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0502 emitted only when every fact has an assignment with two distinct mechanisms, or an explicit NO-INDEPENDENT-INSTRUMENT marker; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0502 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 3 attempts; the gate returns rejected assignments here for re-assignment

stages.title: Reject and re-assign any re-probe that shares a mechanism with the original
One short agent per fact, each forbidden from re-running the briefed probe

body.title: Re-probe one briefed fact with the assigned different instrument

work_unit.title: Confirm or refute one briefed fact using a mechanically different probe
work_unit.question_or_target: Run the assigned instrument. Emit CONFIRMED, REFUTED or UNRESOLVED plus the verbatim probe and output. Re-running the briefed probe does NOT count and must never be reported as CONFIRMED - if that is all you can do, return UNRESOLVED.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: verdict + the exact command or field read + its raw output + a one-line statement of how this differs from the briefed probe
tests_required: a fact whose obvious probe is BROKEN (a Git-Bash `which` against a .cmd shim) must yield: PROBE refuted, FACT confirmed - the two are separate verdicts
a re-probe that ends up re-running the original mechanism must self-report UNRESOLVED with that reason
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: no re-prober sees another's verdict; reconciliation reads probes centrally
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0503 emitted only when exactly one verdict exists for the fact, carrying its probe, its output and the difference statement; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0503 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two instrument failures return UNRESOLVED and demote the fact to a low-confidence assumption

stages.title: Cross-vendor re-probe for any fact that would invalidate more than two lanes

work_unit.title: Second-vendor re-probe of the high-blast-radius facts
work_unit.question_or_target: For every fact whose falsity would invalidate more than two planned lanes, re-probe from a different vendor with no sight of the in-vendor verdict, and record agreement or disagreement.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: vendor independence on exactly the facts whose falsity is most expensive

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per fact: the second-vendor probe, its output, and the agreement flag; a severed dispatch is NOT-CHECKED, never agreement
tests_required: a killed dispatch must produce NOT-CHECKED with the diagnostic tail, never silence
a background receipt string must be rejected outright, never parsed as a verdict
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the reconciler treats NOT-CHECKED as absent evidence and says so in the correction record
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0504 emitted only when every high-blast fact has a second-vendor row carrying a probe and an agreement flag or NOT-CHECKED; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0504 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two severed dispatches record NOT-CHECKED and stop

stages.title: Resolve every split verdict by reading probes, never by counting agents

work_unit.title: Rule on each fact from the probes and emit the brief corrections
work_unit.question_or_target: For each fact, read every probe and rule CONFIRMED / REFUTED / UNRESOLVED. On a split, the more specific probe wins - agent counts are not evidence. Emit the brief corrections, and demote any UNRESOLVED fact from 'ground truth' to 'assumption (low confidence)'.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each ruling names the winning probe and why it is more specific than the loser; a ruling justified by a vote count is invalid
tests_required: seed a 4-refute / 2-confirm split where the 2 re-ran the broken briefed probe - the ruling must be REFUTED and must cite the probe, not the 4
both-states: the same split with the 2 using a genuinely different instrument must NOT be auto-resolved; it must be UNRESOLVED and escalate
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner checkpoint sees the ruling and the raw probes side by side, so the reconciler cannot launder a vote count as a probe
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0505 emitted only when every fact has a ruling naming its winning probe, and the corrections list exists even when empty; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0505 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: a second failure escalates the whole brief to the owner rather than guessing

stages.title: A zero-correction result is itself suspicious - spot-audit it

work_unit.title: Spot-audit three facts by hand when the council found nothing to correct
work_unit.question_or_target: The measured baseline had FOUR false 'VERIFIED GROUND TRUTH' facts in one run, so a zero-correction verdict is more likely a broken council than a perfect brief. Hand-audit three facts, including the highest-blast one, and record whether the council's instruments could have detected a falsehood at all.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: for each audited fact: the instrument used, and an explicit statement of what a FALSE version of this fact would have looked like to that instrument
tests_required: MANDATORY detector control: inject one KNOWN-FALSE fact into the brief - the council must refute it, and this audit must show the instrument that caught it
an instrument that cannot distinguish the true from the false version must be reported as measuring nothing
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner sees this audit before accepting a zero-correction brief
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0506 emitted only when three facts are audited and each carries the would-a-falsehood-be-visible answer; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0506 <failure-class> <reason>

stages.title: Every briefed fact has a verdict and the corrections are emitted
HARD BARRIER: the real fan-out may not start before this point
Owner accepts the corrected brief, or authorises launching anyway
stages.prompt: The re-probe council corrected the brief. Accept the corrections before the fan-out launches, dispute a specific ruling (the probes are attached), or authorise launching on the uncorrected brief and accept the lane risk.

impact.blast_radius: read-only over the brief and the estate; writes only under command-center/preflight/bp-res-05/**

derived_from.credit: measured: 4 of 6 agents refuted, 2 CONFIRMED by re-running the orchestrator's broken probe
the resolution rule: on a split verdict the specific probe wins over the agent count

contraindications: NOT for facts that are cheap to re-measure inline - just measure them
NOT when the brief asserts no facts
the serial barrier is the cost: it delays the fan-out by one short agent per fact
x_extensions.measured_baseline: One run: 4 agents correctly refuted a briefed fact while 2 'CONFIRMED' it by re-running the orchestrator's own broken Git-Bash `which` - complete with dutiful evidence tags. Four briefed 'VERIFIED GROUND TRUTH' facts were false in that single run. That base rate is why zero corrections triggers an audit.
unverified: UNVERIFIED on this estate post-build; settling experiment = a seeded-false-fact run measuring the refutation rate against the 4-of-6 baseline the rule records.

worked_example.name: gate a 40-agent program brief carrying five asserted ground truths
acceptance: a seeded KNOWN-FALSE briefed fact is refuted
a true fact whose obvious probe is broken yields: PROBE refuted, FACT confirmed
the barrier blocks the fan-out until every fact carries a verdict

stopping_rule_controls.why: the floor prevents a brief that extracted zero facts from reading as a clean pass
a fact with no independent instrument must escalate, never silently pass as ground truth
